Title shown after the gun's name
Show card when drawing a weapon
Turns XP gain and level bonuses on or off. Saved levels are kept.
Scales all XP earned from kills.
How much damage each weapon level adds. Each level adds a little less than the one before. 0 turns the bonus off.
Steps through the spend menu: perk points x1, x5, x10, attribute points x1, x5, x10, relic point, refund. Works with a weapon drawn or highlighted in the inventory.
Carries out the option shown on the card. Relic points and refunds ask for a second press.
Which of a gun's titles appears in quotes after its name. Only the name changes: every title a gun has earned always works. If a gun has fewer titles than the choice needs, its strongest is shown.
Tap to step through the spend menu for the weapon highlighted in the inventory, hold and release to use the option shown. Default: Select / View button.
How long the controller spend button must be held to count as a confirm instead of a tap.
How much weapon XP one perk point buys in the spend menu, before the point value below is applied.
How much weapon XP one attribute point buys in the spend menu, before the point value below is applied.

With Better Leveling installed, works out what perk and attribute points are worth from its level cap and points per level, so a point is worth the same share of a playthrough as in the base game. Changes to Better Leveling's settings apply on the next launch. Turn off to use the manual value below.
Scales the XP from perk and attribute points. Used when the automatic value is off or Better Leveling is not installed.
Extra kill XP from each relic point spent. Stacks up to four times.
How many kills a relic boost lasts. Points spent at full strength add this many more kills.
Fire rate, reload speed and recoil improve with weapon level, up to a ceiling at level 20 (10% faster fire, 15% faster reload, 20% less recoil). Applies the next time the weapon is drawn.
Extra XP when the killing blow is a headshot.
Extra XP for killing an enemy who had not noticed you.
Enemies far below your level give half XP. Your level counts as 60 at most, so extended-level saves are not punished.
How many levels below you an enemy has to be to give half XP.
Shows the weapon's level and XP when you draw or swap to it.
How long the card stays on screen.
When drawing a weapon, show only its name and level. The spend menu and level-ups still use the full card.
1: left edge of the screen.  2: right edge. (In menus the card is always at the middle left.)
Where the card sits on the screen during play: 0 is the bottom, 100 the top. The card always stays fully on screen. Default 20 keeps it clear of the game's level-up message.
Writes every counted kill and level change to the WeaponLeveling log for bug reports.
